issues.create.title: Create Issue
issues.create.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

labels.description: Label names to apply to the issue.

assignees.description: GitHub usernames to assign to the issue.

issues.get.title: Get Issue
issues.get.description: Retrieve a single issue from a GitHub repository by its number.

issueNumber.description: Number of the issue to retrieve.

issues.update.title: Update Issue
issues.update.description: Update an existing issue in a GitHub repository — change title, body, state, labels, or assignees.

issueNumber.description: Number of the issue to update.

body.description: New markdown body for the issue.

issues.labels.add.title: Add Labels to Issue
issues.labels.add.description: Add one or more labels to an existing GitHub issue or pull request.

issueNumber.description: Number of the issue or pull request.

labels.description: Full list of labels now on the issue.

issues.comments.create.title: Create Issue Comment
issues.comments.create.description: Add a comment to an existing GitHub issue or pull request.

issueNumber.description: Number of the issue or pull request to comment on.

pull_requests.create.title: Create Pull Request
pull_requests.create.description: Open a new pull request in a GitHub repository from a head branch into a base branch.

head.description: Name of the branch containing the changes (optionally user:branch for cross-fork).

base.description: Name of the branch to merge the changes into.

body.description: Markdown body/description of the pull request.

draft.description: Whether to create the pull request as a draft.

number.description: Pull request number within the repository.

pull_requests.get.title: Get Pull Request
pull_requests.get.description: Retrieve a single pull request from a GitHub repository by its number.

pull_requests.update.title: Update Pull Request
pull_requests.update.description: Update an existing pull request — change title, body, state (open/closed), or base branch.

title.description: New title for the pull request.

body.description: New markdown body for the pull request.

state.description: New state for the pull request.

pull_requests.list_files.title: List Pull Request Files
pull_requests.list_files.description: List files changed in a GitHub pull request including their diff patches.

pull_requests.merge.title: Merge Pull Request
pull_requests.merge.description: Merge an open pull request in a GitHub repository.

pullNumber.description: Number of the pull request to merge.

commitTitle.description: Title for the automatic merge commit message.

commitMessage.description: Extra detail to append to the merge commit message.

mergeMethod.description: Merge strategy to use. Defaults to merge.

merged.description: True when the pull request was merged.

repos.get.title: Get Repository
repos.get.description: Retrieve metadata for a GitHub repository including stars, language, and default branch.

repos.create.title: Create Repository
repos.create.description: Create a new GitHub repository under the authenticated user's account.

name.description: Repository name (must be unique for the user).

private.description: Whether the repository should be private.

autoInit.description: Whether to initialize with a README.

repos.list.title: List Repositories
repos.list.description: List GitHub repositories accessible to the authenticated user.

repos.contents.get.title: Get Repository File Contents
repos.contents.get.description: Get the contents of a file or directory in a GitHub repository. File content is base64-encoded.

path.description: File or directory path within the repository.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) to read from.

contents.description: GitHub contents object (file has type=file and base64 content field).

branches.get.title: Get Branch
branches.get.description: Retrieve branch metadata including the HEAD commit SHA and protection status. A GitHub 'Branch not found' 404 is found=false so branches.delete Reconcile can confirm absence. A generic Not Found (missing repository) stays an error.

found.description: False when the branch does not exist.

branches.create.title: Create Branch
branches.create.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository from a specific commit SHA.

sha.description: The SHA of the commit to branch from.

releases.create.title: Create Release
releases.create.description: Create a GitHub release (optionally as a draft or pre-release) with a tag and release notes.

tagName.description: Tag name for the release (e.g. v1.0.0).

draft.description: Publish as a draft if true.

prerelease.description: Mark as a pre-release if true.

targetCommitish.description: Branch or commit SHA to tag. Defaults to default branch.

gists.create.title: Create Gist
gists.create.description: Create a GitHub Gist with one or more files. Gists can be public or secret.

public.description: Whether the gist is public (true) or secret (false).

files.description: Files to include in the gist.

filename.description: Name of the file including extension.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the GitHub connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

issues.comments.list.title: List Issue Comments
issues.comments.list.description: List comments on a GitHub issue or pull request via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments.

issues.comments.update.title: Update Issue Comment
issues.comments.update.description: Update an issue comment via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{comment_id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.comments.delete.title: Delete Issue Comment
issues.comments.delete.description: Delete an issue comment via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{comment_id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.assignees.add.title: Add Issue Assignees
issues.assignees.add.description: Add assignees to an issue via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/assignees. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.assignees.remove.title: Remove Issue Assignees
issues.assignees.remove.description: Remove assignees from an issue via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/assignees. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.labels.remove.title: Remove Issue Labels
issues.labels.remove.description: Remove one or more labels from an issue via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/labels/{name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.labels.set.title: Set Issue Labels
issues.labels.set.description: Replace all labels on an issue via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/labels. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.lock.title: Lock Issue
issues.lock.description: Lock an issue conversation via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/lock. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

issues.unlock.title: Unlock Issue
issues.unlock.description: Unlock an issue conversation via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/lock. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via issues.get for durability.

labels.list.title: List Repository Labels
labels.list.description: List labels for a repository via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels.

search.issues.title: Search Issues
search.issues.description: Search issues via GET /search/issues. Pull-request-only results are filtered out.

search.pull_requests.title: Search Pull Requests
search.pull_requests.description: Search pull requests via GET /search/issues with is:pr enforced on the query.

q.description: GitHub search query (is:pr appended if missing).

pull_requests.check_merged.title: Check Pull Request Merged
pull_requests.check_merged.description: Check whether a pull request has been merged via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/merge (204 merged, 404 not merged).

pull_requests.commits.list.title: List Pull Request Commits
pull_requests.commits.list.description: List commits on a pull request via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/commits. Distinct from top-level commits.list (repo commits).

pull_requests.convert_to_draft.title: Convert Pull Request to Draft
pull_requests.convert_to_draft.description: Convert an open pull request to draft via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/convert_to_draft. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

pull_requests.mark_ready.title: Mark Pull Request Ready for Review
pull_requests.mark_ready.description: Mark a draft pull request ready for review via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/ready_for_review. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

pull_requests.requested_reviewers.add.title: Add Requested Reviewers
pull_requests.requested_reviewers.add.description: Request reviewers on a pull request via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/requested_reviewers. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

pull_requests.requested_reviewers.remove.title: Remove Requested Reviewers
pull_requests.requested_reviewers.remove.description: Remove requested reviewers from a pull request via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/requested_reviewers. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

pull_requests.review_comments.create.title: Create Pull Request Review Comment
pull_requests.review_comments.create.description: Create a review comment on a pull request diff via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/comments. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

commitId.description: SHA of the commit needing a comment.

path.description: Relative path of the file to comment on.

line.description: Line index in the diff to comment on.

inReplyTo.description: Id of the review comment being replied to.

pull_requests.review_comments.list.title: List Pull Request Review Comments
pull_requests.review_comments.list.description: List review comments on a pull request via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/comments.

pull_requests.review_comments.reply.title: Reply to Pull Request Review Comment
pull_requests.review_comments.reply.description: Reply to an existing pull request review comment via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/comments/{comment_id}/replies. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

commentId.description: Id of the review comment to reply to.

pull_requests.reviews.create.title: Create Pull Request Review
pull_requests.reviews.create.description: Create a review on a GitHub pull request via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

event.description: Review event. Omit or PENDING to leave the review pending.

commitId.description: SHA of the commit to review.

pull_requests.reviews.dismiss.title: Dismiss Pull Request Review
pull_requests.reviews.dismiss.description: Dismiss a pull request review via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews/{review_id}/dismissals. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.get.

message.description: Dismissal message shown in the UI.

pull_requests.reviews.list.title: List Pull Request Reviews
pull_requests.reviews.list.description: List reviews on a GitHub pull request via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews.

actions.workflows.get.title: Get Workflow
actions.workflows.get.description: Get a workflow by id or file name via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}.

workflowId.description: Workflow id or workflow file name (e.g. ci.yml).

actions.runs.get.title: Get Workflow Run
actions.runs.get.description: Get a workflow run via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}.

actions.runs.cancel.title: Cancel Workflow Run
actions.runs.cancel.description: Cancel a workflow run via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/cancel. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.runs.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.runs.get for durability.

actions.runs.rerun.title: Rerun Workflow Run
actions.runs.rerun.description: Rerun a workflow run via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/rerun. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.runs.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.runs.get for durability.

enableDebugLogging.description: Enable debug logging for the rerun.

actions.workflows.dispatch.title: Dispatch Workflow
actions.workflows.dispatch.description: Create a workflow_dispatch event via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/dispatches (204; no run id returned). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.workflows.get using shared owner/repo/workflowId (actions.runs.get cannot observe without a run id). Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.workflows.get for durability.

workflowId.description: Workflow id or workflow file name.

ref.description: Git ref (branch or tag) to run the workflow on.

actions.jobs.list.title: List Workflow Jobs
actions.jobs.list.description: List jobs for a workflow run via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs.

actions.jobs.get.title: Get Workflow Job
actions.jobs.get.description: Get a workflow job via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}.

actions.jobs.logs.get.title: Get Workflow Job Logs
actions.jobs.logs.get.description: Get a short-lived download URL for job logs via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs (302 Location; redirect is not followed).

actions.artifacts.list.title: List Artifacts
actions.artifacts.list.description: List artifacts for a repository (or a specific run when runId is set) via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts or .../runs/{run_id}/artifacts.

runId.description: Optional workflow run id to scope artifacts.

users.get.title: Get Authenticated User
users.get.description: Get the authenticated user via GET /user.

users.get_by_username.title: Get User By Username
users.get_by_username.description: Get a user by login via GET /users/{username}.

users.repos.list.title: List User Repositories
users.repos.list.description: List public repositories for a user via GET /users/{username}/repos.

orgs.list.title: List Authenticated User Organizations
orgs.list.description: List organizations for the authenticated user via GET /user/orgs.

orgs.members.list.title: List Organization Members
orgs.members.list.description: List public members of an organization via GET /orgs/{org}/members.

orgs.repos.list.title: List Organization Repositories
orgs.repos.list.description: List repositories for an organization via GET /orgs/{org}/repos.

checks.runs.list_for_ref.title: List Check Runs For Ref
checks.runs.list_for_ref.description: List check runs for a commit SHA, branch, or tag via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/check-runs.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag.

checks.runs.get.title: Get Check Run
checks.runs.get.description: Retrieve a single check run by ID via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/{check_run_id}.

checks.suites.list_for_ref.title: List Check Suites For Ref
checks.suites.list_for_ref.description: List check suites for a commit SHA, branch, or tag via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/check-suites.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag.

commits.status.get.title: Get Combined Commit Status
commits.status.get.description: Get the combined status for a ref via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/status.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag. Prefer this; `sha` is accepted as an alias.

sha.description: Commit SHA alias for ref. Accepted so EffectPolicy Reconcile can reuse commits.statuses.create input.

commits.statuses.list.title: List Commit Statuses
commits.statuses.list.description: List status contexts for a ref via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/statuses.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag. Prefer this; `sha` is accepted as an alias.

sha.description: Commit SHA alias for ref. Accepted so EffectPolicy Reconcile can reuse commits.statuses.create input.

commits.statuses.create.title: Create Commit Status
commits.statuses.create.description: Create a commit status via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/statuses/{sha}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes combined state via commits.status.get.

sha.description: Commit SHA to attach the status to.

targetUrl.description: URL with more details about this status.

context.description: A string label to differentiate this status from others.

commits.get.title: Get Commit
commits.get.description: Retrieve a single commit by SHA, branch, or tag via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag.

repos.compare.title: Compare Commits
repos.compare.description: Compare two commits via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{base}...{head}. Base and head are path-encoded.

pull_requests.update_branch.title: Update Pull Request Branch
pull_requests.update_branch.description: Update a pull request branch with the latest upstream changes via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/update-branch. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the PR via pull_requests.get.

expectedHeadSha.description: Expected HEAD SHA; update fails if the PR head differs.

branches.list.title: List Branches
branches.list.description: List branches in a repository via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches.

protected.description: Filter to protected (true) or unprotected (false) branches.

labels.get.title: Get Repository Label
labels.get.description: Get a single repository label via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels/{name}. Returns found=false (label=null) when the label is missing (soft 404), so labels.delete Reconcile can confirm absence. When newName is present (labels.update observe input), lookup uses newName.

newName.description: Optional post-rename name; when present, preferred over name for lookup (update Reconcile).

labels.create.title: Create Repository Label
labels.create.description: Create a repository label via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via labels.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via labels.get for durability.

labels.update.title: Update Repository Label
labels.update.description: Update a repository label via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels/{name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via labels.get (prefers newName when renaming). Primary action result is settled first; EffectPolicy returns the observe output.

labels.delete.title: Delete Repository Label
labels.delete.description: Delete a repository label via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels/{name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via labels.get (soft 404 → found=false). Primary action result is settled first; EffectPolicy returns the observe output.

milestones.get.title: Get Milestone
milestones.get.description: Get a milestone via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}. Accepts milestoneNumber or id (Idempotent projection from milestones.create).

milestones.create.title: Create Milestone
milestones.create.description: Create a milestone via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones. EffectPolicy Idempotent projects id (milestone number) from the primary response and observes via milestones.get. Primary action result is settled first; EffectPolicy returns the observe output.

milestones.update.title: Update Milestone
milestones.update.description: Update a milestone via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{milestone_number}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via milestones.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via milestones.get for durability.

dueOn.description: Due date (ISO 8601) or null to clear.

repos.collaborators.add.title: Add Collaborator
repos.collaborators.add.description: Add a repository collaborator via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{username}. 201 = invitation created; 204 = already a collaborator. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.collaborators.check (post-invite may report isCollaborator=false until acceptance). Primary action result is settled first; EffectPolicy returns the observe output.

repos.collaborators.remove.title: Remove Collaborator
repos.collaborators.remove.description: Remove a repository collaborator via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{username}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.collaborators.check. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.collaborators.check for durability.

repos.collaborators.check.title: Check Collaborator
repos.collaborators.check.description: Check whether a user is a collaborator via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{username} (204 = yes, 404 = no).

releases.list.title: List Releases
releases.list.description: List releases for a repository via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases.

releases.get.title: Get Release
releases.get.description: Get a release by id via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}.

releases.get_latest.title: Get Latest Release
releases.get_latest.description: Get the latest published release via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest.

releases.get_by_tag.title: Get Release By Tag
releases.get_by_tag.description: Get a release by tag name via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}.

releases.update.title: Update Release
releases.update.description: Update an existing release via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}.

draft.description: Whether the release is a draft.

prerelease.description: Whether the release is a prerelease.

releases.assets.list.title: List Release Assets
releases.assets.list.description: List assets for a release via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets.

gists.list.title: List Gists
gists.list.description: List gists for the authenticated user via GET /gists.

since.description: Only gists updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

gists.get.title: Get Gist
gists.get.description: Get a gist by id via GET /gists/{gist_id}.

gists.update.title: Update Gist
gists.update.description: Update a gist description or files via PATCH /gists/{gist_id}.

discussions.categories.list.title: List Discussion Categories
discussions.categories.list.description: List discussion categories for a repository via the GitHub GraphQL API (repository.discussionCategories).

discussions.list.title: List Discussions
discussions.list.description: List discussions in a repository via the GitHub GraphQL API (repository.discussions).

answered.description: When set, filter to answered or unanswered discussions.

orderField.description: Sort field: CREATED_AT or UPDATED_AT. Defaults to UPDATED_AT.

orderDirection.description: Sort direction: ASC or DESC. Defaults to DESC.

discussions.get.title: Get Discussion
discussions.get.description: Get one discussion via the GitHub GraphQL API. Looks up by discussionNumber, discussionId, or exact title (so discussions.create Reconcile can observe without a number).

discussionId.description: Discussion GraphQL node id. Used when the number is not known.

discussions.create.title: Create Discussion
discussions.create.description: Create a discussion via the GitHub GraphQL createDiscussion mutation. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.get (title + categoryId). Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.get for durability.

discussions.update.title: Update Discussion
discussions.update.description: Update a discussion via the GitHub GraphQL updateDiscussion mutation. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.get. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.get for durability.

discussionId.description: Discussion GraphQL node id. Used when the number is not known.

discussions.comments.list.title: List Discussion Comments
discussions.comments.list.description: List comments on a discussion via the GitHub GraphQL API.

discussionId.description: Discussion GraphQL node id. Used when the number is not known.

discussions.comments.create.title: Create Discussion Comment
discussions.comments.create.description: Add a discussion comment via the GitHub GraphQL addDiscussionComment mutation. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.comments.list. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.comments.list for durability.

discussionId.description: Discussion GraphQL node id. Used when the number is not known.

replyToId.description: Optional parent comment GraphQL node id when replying.

discussions.comments.update.title: Update Discussion Comment
discussions.comments.update.description: Update a discussion comment via the GitHub GraphQL updateDiscussionComment mutation. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.comments.list. Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via discussions.comments.list for durability.

discussionId.description: Discussion GraphQL node id. Used when the number is not known.

contents.put.title: Put File Contents
contents.put.description: Create or update a file via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.contents.get (accepts branch as ref alias).

branch.description: Branch name to write to. Also accepted as `ref` for Reconcile.

sha.description: Blob SHA of the file being replaced (required for updates).

contents.delete.title: Delete File Contents
contents.delete.description: Delete a file via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}. EffectPolicy Idempotent (double-delete is safe to classify; no reconcile — observe would 404).

sha.description: Blob SHA of the file being replaced (required for updates).

branch.description: Branch name to write to. Also accepted as `ref` for Reconcile.

contents.push_files.title: Push Files (Git Data Compose)
contents.push_files.description: Create a multi-file commit by composing Git Data API calls (get ref → get commit → create blobs → create tree → create commit → update ref). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the branch tip via commits.get (branch accepted as ref).

branch.description: Branch to update. Also accepted as `ref` for Reconcile→commits.get.

files.description: Files to create or update in one commit.

content.description: File content (utf-8 text or base64 when encoding=base64).

expectedHeadSha.description: Optional expected branch tip SHA; fails if tip differs.

git.blobs.create.title: Create Git Blob
git.blobs.create.description: Create a blob via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/blobs. EffectPolicy Idempotent (content-addressed; no reconcile).

git.trees.create.title: Create Git Tree
git.trees.create.description: Create a tree via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees. EffectPolicy Idempotent (content-addressed; no reconcile).

baseTree.description: Optional base tree SHA to update from.

type.description: Entry type: blob, tree, or commit.

sha.description: SHA of the blob/tree (omit when content is set).

git.trees.get.title: Get Git Tree
git.trees.get.description: Get a tree via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{tree_sha}. Set recursive=true to flatten.

recursive.description: When true, return a recursively flattened tree.

git.refs.create.title: Create Git Ref
git.refs.create.description: Create a ref via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs. EffectPolicy Idempotent (no reconcile).

ref.description: Fully qualified ref (refs/heads/...) or heads/... (prefixed automatically).

sha.description: SHA the ref should point to.

git.refs.update.title: Update Git Ref
git.refs.update.description: Update a ref via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/{ref}. EffectPolicy Idempotent (no reconcile).

force.description: Force update even if not a fast-forward.

git.commits.create.title: Create Git Commit
git.commits.create.description: Create a commit via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits. EffectPolicy Idempotent (no reconcile).

repos.tree.get.title: Get Repository Tree
repos.tree.get.description: Get a git tree via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{tree_sha} (optionally recursive). Read helper that wraps the Git Trees API for repository browsing.

recursive.description: When true, return a recursively flattened tree.

pull_requests.comments.list.title: List Pull Request Comments
pull_requests.comments.list.description: List conversation comments on a pull request via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{pull_number}/comments. Diff review comments stay on pull_requests.review_comments.list.

since.description: Only comments updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

repos.update.title: Update Repository
repos.update.description: Update a repository via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.get (name is preferred when renaming). Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via repos.get for durability.

name.description: New repository name. Reconcile observes this name when set.

deleteBranchOnMerge.description: Delete head branches after pull requests merge.

branches.delete.title: Delete Branch
branches.delete.description: Delete a branch via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/heads/{branch}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via branches.get (Branch not found means the branch is gone; a missing repository stays an error). Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via branches.get for durability.

commits.comments.create.title: Create Commit Comment
commits.comments.create.description: Create a commit comment via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{commit_sha}/comments. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via commits.get (sha is accepted as ref). Primary action result is returned; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via commits.get for durability.

path.description: Relative file path the comment applies to.

side.description: LEFT or RIGHT side of the diff.

position.description: Deprecated line position in the diff.
